scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pixel/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web -c gray,cyan,blue "npm:dev -w @pixel/contracts" "npm:dev -w @pixel/api" "npm:dev -w @pixel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pixel/contracts && npm run build -w @pixel/api && npm run build -w @pixel/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pixel/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @pixel/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.migrate:workspaces: npm run build -w @pixel/contracts && npm run migrate:workspaces -w @pixel/api --
